description_en: Queries the metadata data source list by paging and returns the data source type, connection status, and status information of associated profiling nodes
description_zh: 分页查询元数据数据源列表，返回数据源类型、连接状态及关联探查任务的状态信息
kebab_example: aliyun lhm list-meta-data-component-page --category-type WORKFLOW --component-type 0 --ds-name test_ds318_hangzhou_0428 --ds-status 1 --ds-type Hive --ds-type-list Hive --group-by order_date --need-total-count true --order-by gmtCreate --order-direction DESC --page-index 1 --page-size 20 --src-component-id 12345 --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMetaDataComponentPage

parameters.help_en: The category type of the data source. Valid values: DATASET, WORKFLOW, and ENGINE. For scheduling scenarios, this parameter is set to WORKFLOW
parameters.help_zh: 数据源分类类型：DATASET、WORKFLOW、ENGINE。调度场景固定为 WORKFLOW
parameters.name: category_type

parameters.help_en:
The entry component type. In some operations, this parameter is used as a backward compatible field for version 1.1.0. Valid values:
0: source
1: destination
parameters.help_zh: 入口组件类型。部分接口中作为 1.1.0 向下兼容字段使用：0-源端，1-目标端
parameters.name: component_type

parameters.help_en: The data source name. Exact match and fuzzy match are supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据源名称，支持精确匹配或模糊匹配
parameters.name: ds_name

parameters.help_en:
The connectivity status of the data source. Valid values:
0: Not tested.
1: Connected.
2: Connection failed.
-1: Connectivity test not supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据源连通状态：0-未测试，1-连通正常，2-连通失败，-1-不支持连通性测试
parameters.name: ds_status

parameters.help_en: The data source type, such as Hive or MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型，例如 Hive、MaxCompute 等
parameters.name: ds_type

parameters.help_en: The list of data source types
parameters.name: ds_type_list

parameters.help_en: The grouping field (GROUP BY condition). Set this parameter as needed
parameters.help_zh: 分组字段（GROUP BY 条件），按实际情况配置
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the total number of records in the paginated result
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要在分页结果中返回总记录数
parameters.name: need_total_count

parameters.help_en: The sort field. Set this parameter as needed
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，按实际情况配置
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. Valid values:
ASC: ascending order
DESC: descending order
parameters.name: order_direction

parameters.help_en: The page size, which is the number of records returned per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，即每页返回的记录数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The source component ID, which is the primary key of the source data source component
parameters.help_zh: 源端组件 ID，即源端数据源组件的主键标识
parameters.name: src_component_id

schema.description_en: The paging query result object. The totalCount parameter indicates the total number of records that meet the conditional filter criteria. The pageIndex and pageSize parameters echo the paging parameters. The data parameter contains the list of data sources on the current page. The success parameter indicates whether the invocation is successful. If the invocation fails, the errCode and errMessage parameters provide the error code and error message. The requestId parameter uniquely identifies this invocation. Provide this value when troubleshooting issues
schema.description_zh: 分页查询结果对象：totalCount 为符合条件的记录总数，pageIndex 与 pageSize 回显本次分页参数，data 为当前页数据源列表，success 表示调用是否成功，失败时由 errCode 与 errMessage 给出错误编码与错误信息，requestId 唯一标识本次调用，排查问题时请提供该值

data.description_en: The data list returned by the operation. For the structure of each element, see the child parameters
data.description_zh: 接口返回的数据列表，元素结构参见下级子字段说明

items.description_en: A single data source object. For the description of each field, see the child parameters
items.description_zh: 单个数据源对象，字段含义参见下级子字段说明

componentId.description_en: The component ID, which is the primary key of the data source component
